description_en: Updates the instructions on how to use a table. If no instruction on how to use the table is available, the instructions that are configured by calling this operation are added
description_zh: 该接口用于更新表的说明信息，当数据不存在时增加信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-meta-table-intro-wiki --table-guid odps.test.table1 --content abc --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMetaTableIntroWiki

parameters.help_en: The GUID of the table. Specify the GUID in the odps.{projectName}.{tableName} format
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The details of the instructions on how to use the metatable
parameters.name: content
